Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I have again some questions concerning Mask of 1000 Faces :

Dimple attempts a hunt.
David Morgan (+1 intercept against 2 caps and less) attempts to block.
Can Arika mask the action ?

My guess is "No", since David's intercept has been applied and could
not have been if Arika were acting.

If I am wrong and she could, could she play it at superior to gain
stealth ? Dimple needs stealth but Arika wouldn't.

Similarly :

Normal attempts a hunt.
Selma (+1 intercept against Nosferatu) attempts to block.
Even before she gains intercept, Aggrippina wants to play Mask (I
guess she can).
Can she play it at superior to gain stealth ? Normal does not need
stealth but Aggrippina would.

Thank you again !

François.

Yes.

Yes.
Parallel to the reverse case (a minion with inherent +stealth cannot mask at
superior if the superior's stealth is not needed after considering the inherent
stealth).

Key here is he *will* be, but at the time Mask of 1000k is played he
is NOT. Therefore playing the card at superior should be legal. I
see no reason to complicate matters with some wierd ruling. And LSJ
still has not given justification for his ruling. Aristotle's stealth
does not come into play until the Mask of 1000k resolves. At the time
of play, the stealth is needed. After Mask of 1000k resolves and
Aristotle has taken over the action, he is now the acting minion and
you apply his stealth.
